name: iloader
one_liner: A desktop app that makes it easy to install unofficial apps onto an iPhone without going through Apple's App Store.
buyer: Not really a business buyer — this serves individual hobbyists and jailbreak/sideloading enthusiasts who want free apps like emulators that Apple won't allow in its store.
business_use_cases: A niche tech YouTuber builds tutorial content and a Patreon around sideloading and iOS customization, using this tool as the star of their videos.
A small IT shop that supports enterprise-distributed internal iOS apps could reference its certificate-management workflow, though enterprise MDM tools already do this legitimately.
A community Discord server for sideloading enthusiasts grows around it and monetizes through donations or sponsorships, not the software itself.

money_ideas.idea: Accept donations/sponsorships from the sideloading community to sustain development; direct monetization of the tool itself is limited by its free, community nature.

steal_this: Not a real weekend business opportunity — it's a free utility for a hobbyist niche with legal gray areas (bypassing App Store distribution). Content/education around the niche is the only monetizable angle.
